summary: Vodafone Group Plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing a TR-1 notification that Vega SAS crossed a threshold on 13-Jul-2026, reporting a 19.87% total position in Vodafone via financial instruments (Equity Linked Arrangements expiring Feb/Jul 2027) representing 4,574,743,685 voting rights, with 0% direct voting rights. The notification is a regulatory disclosure under UK DTR 5.8.12R of a major holding change, not a transaction. No board recommendation or consideration is provided. This passive stake disclosure does not indicate an active corporate event. Watch for any subsequent activist engagement or regulatory filings clarifying intent.
